pr_body:
Closes #47573 .

Note: there were already annotations on **ref of Directory** and **impl on File**. Doesn't ApiCompact check this?
pr_comments:
Note regarding the `new-api-needs-documentation` label:

This serves as a reminder for when your PR is modifying a ref *.cs file and adding/modifying public APIs, to please make sure the API implementation in the src *.cs file is documented with triple slash comments, so the PR reviewers can sign off that change.

> there were already annotations on ref of Directory and impl on File. Doesn't ApiCompact check this?

@ericstj, @safern?
APICompat doesn't have a way to check nullable annotations yet, however we do plan on fixing this for the 6.0.0 release. Attribute differences should be flagged by APICompat just fine.

issue_context.title: Directory.Exists and File.Exists annotated parameter with [NotNullWhen(true)]
comments: I couldn't figure out the best area label to add to this issue. If you have write-permissions please help me learn by adding exactly one [area label](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/master/docs/area-owners.md).
Adding `[NotNullWhen(true)]` to these is fine.  If the path is null, they return false, and are already documented as such.
No.  It's just a bug in the annotation not reflecting the existing documented semantics of the method. (And, by bug, it's not that the existing annotation is wrong, it could just be more helpful.)

review_comments: System.Collections.Generic was already out of order, but can you move this up to be alphabetical?
